about.metaDescription: Meet ExAI, an open community building and curating delightful software. Recommendations, feedback, and code contributions are all welcome.
about.label: About ExAI
about.heroSubtitle: ExAI is an open software community. We build our own software and curate work by others. We want charming, easy-to-use software to reach more people, and everyone to have a chance to help it grow.
about.originP1: We love software that solves a real problem and feels good to use. Clear interfaces, thoughtful interactions, and small moments of delight matter to us. These experiences guide what we build and what we curate.
about.originP2: Our community includes many open source projects, and welcomes software with different licenses and pricing models. Whatever its license or price, we care about quality and the experience of using it. Check each project for its terms and costs.
about.originP3: Anyone interested can take part. Recommend a tool, share your experience, improve documentation, or open a pull request. We listen to feedback, respond constructively, and keep the process light so suitable contributions can be merged sooner.
about.valuesSubtitle: Discover good work, welcome small contributions, and improve through conversation.
about.githubBody: Explore our open source projects on GitHub, recommend software, share feedback, or help with development.
about.approachCreate: Build with care and a little charm
about.approachNote: Start with a recommendation, a suggestion, or a small change.

projects.metaDescription: Explore software built and curated by ExAI. Discover delightful tools and recommend projects you love to the community.
projects.label: Discover & Create
projects.heroSubtitle: We build software and curate work worth sharing. Start with our community development projects below, and recommend more tools for us to discover. Visit each project for its license, pricing, and ways to contribute.
projects.contributeBody: Recommend your own work or a tool you love, share an experience, or join an existing project. Small suggestions and changes are welcome too.
projects.noDescription: No description yet — check the repo for details.
projects.open-deep-research-with-web-uiDescriptio: An open replication of OpenAI's Deep Research. Features parallel background tasks, real-time streaming UI with Preact, and a full multi-agent pipeline. Built fast, shipped open — because that's how we learn.
projects.comingName: Our next discovery could be yours
projects.comingDescription: Recommend software for the collection, or share an idea you would like to bring to life. Help more good work get discovered.

getInvolved.metaDescription: Join the ExAI community: recommend software, share feedback, improve documentation, or open a PR. Small contributions are welcome.
getInvolved.label: Everyone is welcome
getInvolved.heroSubtitle: Whether you use software, make it, or are just starting to explore, you are welcome here. Recommend something, share your experience, or contribute a small improvement.
getInvolved.waysTitle: Find your way to take part
getInvolved.waysSubtitle: Start with something you care about. No expertise required.
getInvolved.card1Body: Fix a small bug, improve the docs, or open a PR with a new feature. We respond constructively, help refine changes, and aim to make suitable contributions easy to merge.
getInvolved.card2Body: Share your own creation or a tool you discovered. Tell us what it does, what you like about it, and where people can try it.
getInvolved.card3Body: What feels great? What is confusing? Which small detail could be better? Share your experience in the discussion to help improve our software and collection.
getInvolved.issuesBody: Browse open issues or suggest an improvement of your own. First pull request? You are welcome here. We will help refine your contribution and keep unnecessary back-and-forth to a minimum.
getInvolved.finalBody: A recommendation, some feedback, or a code contribution can all make a difference. Bring your curiosity and ideas, and join the conversation.
getInvolved.participation1: Try a tool that catches your eye
getInvolved.participation4: Improve the docs or open a PR
getInvolved.participation5: Talk it through and make it better

values.delightBody: We care about the problems software solves and how it feels to use. Thoughtful details can make everyday life easier and a little more joyful.
values.discoverBody: We build our own software and curate good work by others. Open source, free, or paid, a thoughtful experience deserves to be discovered.
values.communityBody: Recommend a tool, share feedback, improve the docs, or open a PR. We respond constructively and help suitable contributions find their way in.
values.listenBody: We take users and creators seriously. Community feedback helps shape our software and the collection we share.
